architectureDecisions: D1: Add recoveryDir=null to existing runSupervisedBackendWork options and pass that exact value to its first runSupervisedTask call. No other adapter control-flow or result-schema changes. Leave dynamic supervisor import intact to avoid package cycle.

D2: Delivered supervisor owns recoveryDir validation, handle writes and HANDLE_CURRENT rejection. Reuse AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V1; add no callback, handle format or resume call. With recoveryDir the first invocation persists ACT_COMPLETED/RUNNING before verification and terminal ACCEPTED before adapter re-grounding. The later adapter re-ground checkout is separately owned and still disposed in finally.

D3: Omitted recoveryDir remains null; delivered supervisor uses/disposes its mkdtemp run worktree. Existing adapter also disposes its separate re-ground worktree. Caller owns an opted-in retained handle/worktree after return; only fixture cleanup disposes a verified matching handle.

D4: Focused tests use real scratch Git plus delivered fake-agent, literal verifier argv and invocationObserver cwd capture. P1 reads handle during verifier and after return. N1 repeats the actual adapter call with same current handle; N2 omits the option. No first invocationObserver handle-existence assertion: handle persistence occurs later.

D5: Capture source HEAD, sorted refs/heads and porcelain including untracked files before each case; compare exact snapshots afterwards. Empty/string-invalid/non-string options reject before fake agent dispatch. Driver interruption after persisted ACT_COMPLETED is a separate persistence fixture, not a resume implementation.

D6: Update only Application state/capabilities descriptions of execute persistence, omitted cleanup and duplicate-run rejection; recover/resume stays the Board factory. Focused/regression/docs/repository checks and independent Worker judgment precede delivery.
implementationSlices: S1 — supervised-backend.js: add only recoveryDir=null option and recoveryDir property at runSupervisedTask call (D1). Keep all validation, acceptedSha mapping, re-grounding and finally cleanup unchanged. Delivered supervisor implements D2-D3 without edits. Covers RECOVERY_FORWARDING, RECOVERY_RETAINED, OMITTED_CLEANUP, INVALID_RECOVERY and EXECUTE_ONLY. Exact patch: append recoveryDir=null after invocationObserver=null in the existing options destructure; add recoveryDir as a sibling property in the existing runSupervisedTask object. Source-copy replay implements precisely these two edits and real delivered supervisor behavior; no hypothetical adapter API is used.

S2 — bb142-adapter-recovery.test.js: implement literal negativeCaseBindings titles N1/N2 and separate P1 persisted execute, P3 invalid directory, P4 execute-only checks as specified by acceptanceCriteria. Every dynamic case directly invokes runSupervisedBackendWork. P1 validates handle twice and retained candidate after return; N1 rejects duplicate before dispatch; N2 proves captured cwd removal. Compare unchanged source snapshots in P1/N1/N2. Optional driver interruption control asserts persisted RUNNING bytes survive; it never resumes.

S3 — declared Application Living docs: describe optional execute persistence and caller ownership, omitted disposal, HANDLE_CURRENT duplicate rejection and Board-only recovery. Run focused, agentic-regression, docs and repository checks. Future Worker records exact candidate/log hashes; current research binds objective, source baseline, prototype result and final plan for independent readiness.
